text: THE HOME PAGE CARRIES THE PRIME MINISTER'S QUOTE — DBIM 3.0 §7.3(iv), ANNEXURE CHECKLIST D. Option 1 of the three in Figma ("05 · PM Quote — Options"): the department's pale brand tint, the quote in the darkest brand ink DBIM asks for, the attribution with its event and date, a link to the address, and the photograph at the right on a decorative chakra. It sits after the banner and before the Ministry section, which is DBIM's own homepage order. The quote is verbatim from PIB's rendering of the Address to the Nation on the 79th Independence Day, Red Fort, 15 August 2025 (PRID 2156749); it names social justice outright, and it is the one to replace when a newer sector quote is issued. Contrast measured on the band: 6.06:1 for the quote and the link, 11.41 and 7.7 for the attribution.
